title: Monday Leadership Check-in
summary: Discussion covered Pricing v3, AI Copilot, Enterprise forecast, Security. The team reached 3 clear decision(s) and assigned follow-up work.
decisions: Launch Pricing v3 in September after migration testing
Start AI Copilot beta with 25 customers next week
Make security review acceleration a cross-functional revenue priority

action_items.task: Launch Pricing v3 in September after migration testing
Start AI Copilot beta with 25 customers next week
Make security review acceleration a cross-functional revenue priority

transcript.speaker: Aditi Rao
transcript.text: Let's focus today's discussion on Pricing v3, AI Copilot, Enterprise forecast.

transcript.speaker: Rohan Mehta
transcript.text: From the platform side, we can support this, but we should define the technical boundary clearly.

transcript.speaker: Arjun Malhotra
transcript.text: The product problem is not lack of ideas. It is choosing the smallest set that creates repeat value.

transcript.speaker: Meera Iyer
transcript.text: The market signal is consistent across the larger deals, especially in the US enterprise segment.

transcript.speaker: Nisha Kapoor
transcript.text: The customer pattern matters more than the loudest individual request. We should act on repeat behavior.

transcript.speaker: Kabir Shah
transcript.text: I am comfortable with the investment if we can see the unit economics and the downside case.

transcript.speaker: Tara Menon
transcript.text: The message will work better if we can show proof rather than another list of features.

transcript.speaker: Aditi Rao
transcript.text: My recommendation is that we launch Pricing v3 in September after migration testing.

transcript.speaker: Rohan Mehta
transcript.text: My recommendation is that we start AI Copilot beta with 25 customers next week.

transcript.speaker: Arjun Malhotra
transcript.text: My recommendation is that we make security review acceleration a cross-functional revenue priority.

transcript.speaker: Aditi Rao
transcript.text: Okay, we are aligned on make security review acceleration a cross-functional revenue priority. Let's capture owners and move.
